newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends down on commission selling.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends down on commission selling.

text.p: Earlier weakness on London's December white sugar contract continued in late trading after a wave of commission house selling caused values to tumble, traders said on Monday.
The benchmark contract extended earlier losses to end down $6.60 at $331.90 having turned over 1,357 lots and the March contract was $4.80 adrift at $332.00 on a volume of 1,110 lots.
"It's certainly looking weak," said one trader, adding that a fund might be behind at least some of the sales by a leading commission house.
One major trade house was also reported to have sold December positions, compounding the weakness.
Volume was concentrated in the two front positions.
The trading pattern had been similar in Paris, where all positions were lower. December was down $6.00 at $333.00 and March down $4.40 at $333.60.
